note: These briefs describe the rooms. They are not a generation order. No plate was regenerated for this record.

briefs.spatial_role: Threshold and quiet interior rooms for account, trust, and privacy.
briefs.architectural_character: Atrium plaster, then smaller clean rooms per screen.
briefs.lighting_character: High natural light on the welcome plate. Child rooms stay calm.
briefs.hero_object_or_focal_point: The welcome atrium. Each later entry screen has its own plate.
briefs.negative_space_strategy: Open plaster for the live column.
briefs.relationship_to_previous_family: First family. It establishes the world.

briefs.emotional_role: Setting the life in order. Considered, not hurried.
briefs.spatial_role: Four rooms: arrival, desk, edit, quiet.
briefs.architectural_character: Coastal arch at arrival. Travertine desk for the working screens. A stone ledge for edit. A lower pier for permission.
briefs.lighting_character: Morning side light. Warm on the quiet plate.
briefs.material_emphasis: Plaster, travertine, burgundy cloth, olive, paper.
briefs.hero_object_or_focal_point: Arrival bust and arch. Desk holds the closed burgundy ledger and brass tray.
briefs.negative_space_strategy: Left plaster stays empty for the form.
briefs.relationship_to_previous_family: Same world as F01. Its own rooms. The live setup routes do not mount the F01 atrium file.

briefs.emotional_role: Open, brighter, lived-in, daily, active, more expansive than setup.
briefs.spatial_role: The daily home. One environment group for the parent and its states.
briefs.architectural_character: A different room from F02 arrival. Not the same arch, curtain, bust, bowl, and book stack.
briefs.lighting_character: Brighter day light than the setup arrival.
briefs.material_emphasis: Lived-in plaster, textile, a daily object. Still stone and bone.
briefs.hero_object_or_focal_point: A daily focal point that is not the F02 bust-and-arch arrangement.
briefs.negative_space_strategy: Left and center-left stay open for the safe-to-spend rail. The right plate breathes.
briefs.relationship_to_previous_family: After setup. Same house, a more active room.
briefs.current_plate_status: MOUNTED_FOR_REVIEW. TODAY.ENVIRONMENT.DAY.001 is now the plate derived from F03.00_TODAY_AUTHORITY_FIRST. It is not the arrival room. Founder status is UNREVIEWED.

briefs.emotional_role: Quieter, editorial, ledger-like, structured, less photographically busy than Today.
briefs.spatial_role: A reading room for the record. One environment group for the parent, search, and detail.
briefs.architectural_character: Broad plaster. The arch is only a sliver. No bust.
briefs.lighting_character: Soft diagonal light on a large empty wall.
briefs.material_emphasis: Plaster, burgundy textile, a small stack of books.
briefs.hero_object_or_focal_point: The empty wall. Objects stay low and out of the reading field.
briefs.negative_space_strategy: Most of the frame is quiet plaster so the ledger can sit without fighting a sculpture.
briefs.relationship_to_previous_family: Same house as Today. Not Today's bust, bowl, and full arch.
briefs.current_plate_status: DISTINCT from F03. Unique file. Still the coastal house, which is the world, not a second copy of the Today plate.
